description: A React functional component named TemplateSelect that provides a UI for selecting between two types of Statement of Work (SOW): Fixed Price (FP) and Time & Materials (TM). It renders buttons for each option and communicates selection changes via an onChange callback.

methods.name: TemplateSelect({ selected, onChange })
